g.text: How LLM Cooperation Changes Across Strategic Incentives

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Each square shows observed cooperation (%) at one tested S–T pair. Defection = 100% − cooperation.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #46515a

g.text: R = 1 (both cooperate) · P = 0 (both defect) · Both axes show every tested value, at 0.25 intervals.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #46515a

g.text: 13 × 13 measured payoff pairs per model · two label blocks · normally 2 games / 4 decisions per square.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #46515a

g.text: * Only 1 valid game / 2 decisions in this square. Percentages are observed frequencies, not precise population probabilities.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #46515a

g.text: Dashed lines: S = 0 and T = 1 regime boundaries. Strict Prisoner’s Dilemma is S < 0, T > 1. No interpolation or new model calls.
